value.name: Miles waits alone in conference room
value.description: Miles sits alone in the conference room, looking sadly out the window before the others arrive.
evidence: Miles sits gazing sadly out the window.
The room is empty.

value.name: Marylin enters with Ruth
value.description: Marylin arrives in the conference room with Ruth, who takes a seat and opens her attach case.
evidence: Marylin walks in, chic and beautiful as ever, followed by Ruth, who sits next to her, places her attach case on the table top, and snaps its clasps.

value.name: Lawyers begin settlement meeting
value.description: Ruth and Wrigley take control of the meeting as the legal negotiation begins.
evidence: RUTH Alright.
WRIGLEY Ruth.

value.name: Miles and Marylin exchange strained greetings
value.description: Miles and Marylin acknowledge each other awkwardly, signaling the emotional distance between them.
evidence: Miles and Marylin are looking at each other.
MILES Hello Marylin.
MARYLIN Hello Miles.

value.name: Miles blames Marylin for his ruined marriage
value.description: Miles says he cannot believe their relationship is ending and accuses Marylin of hiring a killer to murder him.
evidence: MILES Hard to believe this is the way it will end up for us.
MILES But then -- I guess -- something inside me died when I realized that you'd hired a goon to kill me.

value.name: Marylin accuses Miles in return
value.description: Marylin responds by saying she felt the same way when she believed Miles had hired someone to kill him.
evidence: MARYLIN Yes. I know. It's exactly how I felt when I realized you'd hired the goon to kill...

value.name: Ruth denies any murder plot
value.description: Ruth interrupts to insist that neither side actually hired anyone to kill anyone.
evidence: RUTH Now you both wait a minute. Nobody hired anyone to kill anyone.

value.name: Wrigley explains burglar's death
value.description: Wrigley clarifies that a burglar broke into the house, became despondent, and shot himself.
evidence: WRIGLEY Apparently, from what I can gather, a burglar broke into your house -- became despondent over his lifestyle and shot himself.

value.name: Miles asks where they stand
value.description: Miles asks what the situation means for their relationship and future.
evidence: MILES Where does that leave us?

value.name: Ruth presents settlement agreement
value.description: Ruth slides a proposed settlement across the table and says it is generous.
evidence: RUTH We've outlined a settlement...
She pushes a piece of paper across the table.
RUTH We think it's more than generous.

value.name: Miles ignores settlement offer
value.description: Miles refuses to engage with the settlement paper and keeps his attention on Marylin.
evidence: Miles ignores the paper, which lies unclaimed on the middle of the table.
He looks at Marylin.

value.name: Wrigley offers reconciliation
value.description: Wrigley states that his client is willing to consider reconciling rather than separating.
evidence: WRIGLEY My client is prepared to consider a reconciliation.

value.name: Marylin begins to respond
value.description: Marylin looks at Miles and starts to answer, suggesting the negotiation is turning toward a personal decision.
